privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.seo_title: Privacy Policy | How We Protect Your Data at Raks.pk
privacy-policy.seo_desc: Read Raks.pk's Privacy Policy to learn how we collect, use, and protect your data. Your privacy matters—stay informed about our policies.
privacy-policy.content:
At Raks, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that your personal information is handled responsibly. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you visit or interact with our website. 1. Information We Collect We may collect the following types of information:
  • Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, shipping and billing address, and payment details when you make a purchase or sign up for our services.
  • Account Information: Details you provide when creating an account, such as login credentials.
  • Browsing Information: Data about your interactions with our website, including IP address, browser type, device information, and cookies.
2. How We Use Your Information We use your information for the following purposes:
  • To process and fulfill orders, including payment and delivery.
  • To communicate with you about your orders, inquiries, or promotional offers.
  • To improve our website, services, and user experience.
  • To comply with legal obligations and prevent fraudulent activities.
3. Sharing Your Information We respect your privacy and will never sell your personal information. However, we may share your data with trusted third parties for the following purposes:
  • Service Providers: To process payments, deliver orders, or provide technical support.
  • Legal Requirements: If required to comply with applicable laws, regulations, or legal proceedings.
  • Business Transfers: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of our business, your data may be transferred as part of the transaction.
4. Cookies and Tracking Technologies Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience and collect data about your preferences. Cookies allow us to:
  • Remember your login details and preferences.
  • Provide personalized recommendations and targeted advertising.
  • Analyze website traffic and performance.
You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings. However, disabling cookies may impact certain website features. 5. Data Security We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. However, no online transmission is entirely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute data security. 6. Your Rights You have the following rights regarding your personal information:
  • Access: Request a copy of the information we hold about you.
  • Correction: Update or correct inaccurate information.
  • Deletion: Request that we delete your personal data, subject to legal or contractual obligations.
  • Opt-Out: Unsubscribe from marketing emails or adjust cookie preferences.
To exercise these rights, please contact us using the details provided below. 7. Third-Party Links Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these websites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before sharing your data. 8. Children’s Privacy Raks does not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 16. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child, we will delete it promptly. 9. Updates to This Policy We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page, and the "Last Updated" date will reflect the most recent revision. 10. Contact Us If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, please contact us at: Email: raks@gmail.com Last updated: 9 September 2026

terms-condition.title: Terms & Condition
terms-condition.seo_desc: Read Raks's Terms & Conditions to know about shopping policies, payments, returns, and more. Stay informed before placing your order!
terms-condition.content:
Welcome to Raks These terms and conditions outline the rules and regulations for using our website and services. By accessing or purchasing from our website, you agree to comply with these terms. 1. General Information
  • Raks operates this website to provide information and sell products, including lingerie, nightwear, and accessories.
  • These terms apply to all users, including browsers, vendors, customers, merchants, and contributors of content.
2. Eligibility
  • By using our website, you confirm that you are at least the age of majority in your state or province of residence.
  • Any purchases made by individuals under the age of majority must have parental or guardian approval.
3. Product Information
  • We strive to display our products as accurately as possible. However, colors, styles, and sizes may vary slightly due to screen settings or manufacturing variations.
  • All products are subject to availability. We reserve the right to limit quantities or discontinue items without notice.
4. Pricing and Payment
  • All prices are listed in Pakistani Rupees (PKR) and include applicable taxes unless stated otherwise.
  • Cash on Delivery is available across Pakistan. Payment options are shown at checkout.
5. Promotions and Discounts
  • Promotions, offers, and discounts are subject to specific terms and conditions, which will be detailed at the time of the offer.
  • Discounts cannot be combined unless explicitly stated.
6. Shipping and Delivery
  • We deliver across Pakistan. Delivery times may vary based on location, courier availability, and stock.
  • Raks is not responsible for delays caused by unforeseen circumstances, including customs or courier issues.
7. Returns and Exchanges
  • We accept size exchanges for unworn, undamaged items with tags intact, in their original packaging, within 15 days of delivery.
  • Certain items, such as intimate products, may not be eligible for returns due to hygiene reasons.
  • Exchanges are processed once the returned item has been received and inspected.
8. Intellectual Property
  • All content on this website, including text, images, logos, and designs, is the property of Raks and is protected by copyright laws.
  • You may not reproduce, distribute, or use any content without prior written consent.
9. Privacy Policy
  • Your privacy is important to us. Please review our Privacy Policy to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
10. Limitation of Liability
  • Raks is not liable for any direct, indirect, or incidental damages resulting from the use of our website or products.
  • We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation of the website.
11. Changes to Terms
  • We reserve the right to update or modify these terms at any time without prior notice. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting.
12. Governing Law
  • These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Pakistan.
13. Contact Us If you have any questions about these terms, please contact us at: Email: raks@gmail.com Last updated: 9 September 2026

about-us.title: About Us
about-us.seo_title: About RAKS Journey - Best Quality Bra & Lingerie Brand in Pakistan
about-us.seo_desc: Read about RAKS which offers premium lingerie & nightwear in Pakistan. Shop from one of the best bra brands in Pakistan. Order online now
about-us.content:
What is RAKS?

RAKS is an online store selling women's lingerie, bras, nightwear, pyjamas, panties and shapewear across Pakistan. Prices are in Pakistani Rupees, Cash on Delivery is available nationwide, and every order is sent in plain, unbranded packaging.

What are we trying to do?

Our journey began with a simple idea: nightwear and lingerie that blend comfort, elegance and affordability. We look for fabrics that feel good to wear all day, fits that hold their shape after washing, and prices that stay within reach.

Comfortable fabrics

Soft, breathable materials chosen for everyday wear. Each product page lists that product's own composition.

Fair pricing

Affordable options that offer lasting value without compromising on quality.

Durable construction

Made to hold up to regular washing and everyday wear.

Practical finish

Fastenings, straps and seams designed to stay comfortable through a full day.

What does RAKS sell?

Bras in everyday, T-shirt, padded, non-padded, push-up, sports, minimizer, nursing and bridal styles. Nightwear including nighties, nightgowns, night suits and bridal sets. Pyjama sets, panties and shapewear. Sizes and available colours are listed on each product page. View collection

How do I find my size?

Every product page lists the sizes in stock for that item. If you are between sizes or unsure which to order, email us with your usual size and the product you are considering, and we will suggest a fit.

How do orders arrive?

We deliver across Pakistan with Cash on Delivery available. Orders are packed in plain, unbranded packaging, so nothing on the outside identifies what is inside.

How do I get in touch?

Call or WhatsApp 0339 5400416, or email raks@gmail.com. We aim to reply within 24 hours on business days. You can also read our frequently asked questions or browse the RAKS Journal for fit and fabric guides. View all products

contact-us.title: Contact Us
contact-us.seo_title: Contact RAKS | Get in Touch for Support & Queries
contact-us.seo_desc: Need help? Contact RAKS for support, inquiries, or feedback. We're here to assist you with your orders, products, and any questions you have!
contact-us.content:
How do I contact RAKS?

Call or WhatsApp 0339 5400416, or email raks@gmail.com. We aim to respond within 24 hours on business days. RAKS is based in Lahore and delivers across Pakistan.

What can we help with?

  • Order status — send your order number and the phone number used at checkout.
  • Sizing and fit — tell us your usual size and which product you are looking at, and we will suggest a fit.
  • Exchanges — email your order number and the size you would like instead.
  • Product questions — fabric, colour, measurements and availability.

Where does RAKS deliver?

We deliver across Pakistan. Cash on Delivery is available, and every order is sent in plain, unbranded packaging. For questions about delivery, payment, sizing and exchanges, see our frequently asked questions.
